input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Response.__init__ reads self.raw.reason to initialize reason, but raw has no underlying response object yet at construction time, so the attribute access dereferences None.
- failure path: Any call that builds a Response, such as every adapter.send or a plain Response(), raises AttributeError ('NoneType' object has no attribute 'reason') before the object is populated, so no request can complete.

Reviewer finding
- description: In Response.__init__, self.raw is still None when this line runs, so self.raw.reason raises AttributeError and every Response() construction fails.
- rationale: Trigger: any call to Response() with no arguments, which runs the constructor, including the library's own uses and tests. Mechanism: __init__ assigns self.raw = None earlier in the method, so the attribute access on None fails before the object is initialized. Impact: constructing a Response crashes instead of returning an object with reason None or an empty string.
critique: Both describe Response.__init__ reading self.raw.reason while raw is None at construction. That attribute access raises AttributeError, so every Response construction fails. Same operation, same mechanism.
